nodes.label: SNES/SPC700 hardware constraints (8 channels, 16-bit PCM, ~64KB sample RAM, 64-row patterns)
nodes.norm_label: snes/spc700 hardware constraints (8 channels, 16-bit pcm, ~64kb sample ram, 64-row patterns)
nodes.rationale: Explains why the converter truncates samples, caps total PCM (96KB budget) and forces <=8 channels: the SPC700 has ~64KB of sample RAM and only 8 voices, and smconv converts 16-bit PCM to BRR.
